provenance: Study 006's S1 patches (auths-research studies/006-formal-comparison-prior-art/harness/formal/s1, checked by its second rater), one per case of the matrix.

edits.note: windowContained: the lower-bound test parent.start ≤ child.start is reversed.
windowContained: the upper-bound test child.finish ≤ parent.finish is reversed.
evaluateAuthorScope's permission test: child and parent swapped in ⊆.
evaluateAuthorScope's audience test: child and parent swapped in ⊆.
evaluateCoverage's permission test: ∉ becomes ∈ (membership negated).
evaluateCoverage's audience test: ∉ becomes ∈ (membership negated).
actionConstraintAllows, allowed-body arm: ∈ becomes ∉.
actionConstraintLe, allowed-under-allowed arm: child and parent swapped in ⊆.
actionConstraintAllows, exact-body arm: any digest is accepted.

actionConstraintLe, allowed-under-exact arm: also accepts any allowed set that contains the parent's digest, so a multi-digest set is accepted beneath an exact parent; the empty set stays accepted (revised to the second rater's form, S1 check 1).
actionConstraintLe, allowed-under-exact arm: strict subset, so the singleton {d} is rejected beneath Exact(d); the empty set stays accepted (revised to the second rater's form, S1 check 1).
budgetLe: the numeric test child.value ≤ parent.value is reversed.
budgetLe: the algebra-identifier equality is dropped.

edits.before:
(child parent : Option (BudgetCeiling v)) : Prop :=
  match child, parent with
  | _, none => True
  | none, some _ => False
edits.after:
(child parent : Option (BudgetCeiling v)) : Prop :=
  match child, parent with
  | _, none => True
  | none, some _ => True
edits.note: budgetLe: the arm (none, some _) becomes True.
budgetCovers: the arm (some ceiling, no request) becomes True.
statusLe: the maximum-age test is reversed.
statusLe: the status-method equality is dropped.

edits.before:
(left : ProfileRef) (right : ProfileRef) : Result Bool := do
  if left.version = right.version
edits.after:
(left : ProfileRef) (right : ProfileRef) : Result Bool := do
  if True
edits.note: the translated auths_model.profile_ref_equal (the witness is stated against it): the version test becomes True, so only the identifiers are compared.
evaluateAuthorScope's assurance test: distinct identifiers never refuse.

edits.before:
∃ entry ∈ child.entries, entry.id = parentEntry.id ∧
    extensionLawAccepts parentEntry.id (some entry.body) (some parentEntry.body)
edits.note: extensionRetained: the identifier's law is no longer applied.
scopeDepthChecks: < becomes ≤, so equal depth is accepted.

rootPreserved: the issuer-subject equality is always true. The rich model's principals are opaque carriers with no DID-method component, so 'distinct principals using the same DID method' can only be rendered as 'distinct principals'.

edits.after:
rootPreserved parent grant ∧
    ((grant.parent.isSome = true ∧ parent.lastGrant.isSome = true) ∨
      grant.parent = parent.lastGrant)
edits.note: linked: any two present grant identifiers compare equal.
